name: Dr. Ram Kumar Pathak
title: Assistant Librarian, CAS; Digital Library In-Charge, AKTU Central Digital Library
bio: Dr. Ram Kumar Pathak has served as Digital Library In-Charge and Assistant Librarian at CAS AKTU since April 2018. He previously served as Chief Librarian at Vidya Knowledge Park, Meerut (2006-18), and Librarian at Pioneer Institute of Academics, Meerut (2000-05).
